subject.title: MCP loopback transport does not auto-reconnect on CLI side after gateway restart — recovered=1 is misleading

question: After the shared-loopback teardown repair lands, should `recovered` continue to mean session-content admission only, or should it require verified MCP tool reachability and report a distinct partial-recovery state otherwise?
rationale: The candidate PR can remove a demonstrated lifecycle defect without choosing the durable user-facing contract for recovery status; that meaning affects recovery reporting and any future verification or reconnect design.

options.title: Keep content-only recovery semantics
options.body: Land the narrow shared-loopback cleanup repair and document or rename the status so it does not imply restored tool capability.

options.title: Define verified recovery
options.body: Require a reachability check or explicit partial-recovery state before presenting a session as fully recovered.

recommendation.title: Define verified recovery
recommendation.body: Require a reachability check or explicit partial-recovery state before presenting a session as fully recovered.

likelyOwner.reason: The current cleanup behavior and its loopback lifecycle ownership trace to this contributor’s feature history.
